title: Az első szabad választások és az Antall-kormány (First Free Elections & Democratic Governance)
grammar: Constitutional Proclamations, Negotiated Democracy & Sovereign Historical Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when the first free elections were held and which party won the most seats.
I can say who formed the government and who became President.
I can say when the last Soviet soldier left Hungary.
I can use the past tense to say who formed a government and who left the country.
